data.spiritual_meaning: Meg expresses “Mighty”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meg total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

in_hebrew.name: Meg
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Meg הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word megas, meaning great or mighty.

in_greek.name: Meg
in_greek.long_meaning: Meg είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word megas, meaning great or mighty.

in_latin.name: Meg
in_latin.long_meaning: Meg est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word megas, meaning great or mighty.
